name: Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension Scheme (IGNOAPS - NSAP)

slots.name: age
slots.description: Age of the applicant in completed years.

slots.name: is_bpl
slots.description: Does the applicant belong to a Below Poverty Line (BPL) household according to official government criteria?

slots.name: receives_other_pension
slots.description: Is the applicant receiving any other government pension above BPL limits?

rules.reason: Applicant must be at least 60 years of age to qualify for Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension.
Applicant must belong to an officially certified Below Poverty Line (BPL) household.
Applicants receiving other substantial government retirement or social security pensions are excluded.

rules.condition: age >= 60 and is_bpl == true and receives_other_pension == false
rules.reason: You satisfy both the age requirement (60+ years) and the BPL socioeconomic criteria under NSAP guidelines.

documents: Age Proof Document (Aadhaar Card, Voter ID, or Birth Certificate)
BPL Card / BPL Survey Inclusion Certificate from Gram Panchayat
Bank Account / Post Office Savings Account Passbook
next_steps: Submit the completed application form to your Gram Panchayat Secretary, Block Development Office (BDO), or the District Social Welfare Department.
